name: Terminal / TUI Web
summary: A monospace grid, box-drawing borders, a dark or phosphor ground and keyboard hints. It borrows from command-line tools and text user interfaces to make web pages that feel like a terminal.

philosophy.core_thesis: The terminal is the honest interface: a fixed character grid, text only and a keyboard make a tool fast and trustworthy.
design_principles: Set every character on a fixed grid: one monospace at 14px to 16px, character width 8px to 10px, line height 20px to 24px.
Align all blocks to whole characters and whole lines; widths are multiples of 1 ch and heights multiples of 1 line.
Draw borders with box-drawing characters (┌ ─ ┐ │ └ ┘) or a 1px line snapped to the grid; corner radius is 0px.
Use 2 to 4 colours: a dark ground (#0C0C0C), one text colour, one accent and an alert colour; green or amber on black for a phosphor look.
Show a prompt (>, $ or ▌) and a blinking block cursor at 1s intervals (500ms on, 500ms off).
Show keyboard shortcuts in brackets, for example [q] quit, [/] search, at 12px to 14px next to each action.
Use ASCII art, bars (▁▂▃▅▇) and text spinners (⠋⠙⠹) instead of images and icons.

layout.grid_mechanics: A character grid of 80 to 120 columns; each block spans whole columns and lines; the gutter is 1 character.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 20% to 30% of the surface is empty, in whole lines; spacing is 1 or 2 lines and 1 or 2 characters.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush left on the grid; numbers right-aligned in columns; headers in boxes.
layout.container_geometry: Boxes with 0px radius drawn by a 1px line or box-drawing characters; panels split by single lines.

font_pairings.note: A clear coding face with ligatures off for an exact grid.
A technical mono with a warm voice.
A bitmap-style mono for a CRT look.

typography.tracking: Tracking stays at 0 so the grid holds.
typography.leading: Line height is a fixed 1.5 on a 16px face: 24px.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: regular (400) and bold (700).
Use one size, 14px to 16px; headers differ by bold, case and box, not by size.
Set headers in upper case in bold.

color.palette_structure: Dark ground, one phosphor colour and an alert colour.
color.contrast_rules: Phosphor on console holds at least 13:1; dim text holds at least 4.5:1; amber marks selection and warnings.
color.surface_treatment: Flat black with an optional scanline overlay of 2px stripes at 4% opacity; no gradient.
color.light_and_shadow: None; an optional glow of 4px blur in the text colour at 30% for a CRT look.

materiality.surface_simulation: A cathode-ray terminal: a flat dark field with glowing characters.
materiality.border_rules: A single line of 1px in the dim colour or box-drawing characters; no thick border.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur and no elevation; an optional text-shadow of 0 0 4px at 30% for glow.

ornamentation_details.iconography: No icons; use characters (▶ ✓ ✗ ● ○) and bracketed keys.
ornamentation_details.illustration: ASCII art, text charts and block-character progress bars.

motion.transition_physics: Stepped, discrete: the cursor blinks at 1s; text types at 30 to 80 characters per second; spinners cycle at 80ms per frame.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover inverts the row (text and ground swap); active state shows the amber ground.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels the speed and honesty of a tool made by and for experts.

avoid_when: The audience is a general consumer.
The page needs rich images or brand warmth.

modifiers.how: Add a proportional UI face, hairlines at 8% white and a 6px radius; keep the mono for data.
Switch to a white ground, default links and 1px black rules.
Add neon pink and cyan and a perspective grid; keep the mono.

pack.why: A pixel family made on a strict square grid that fits a character-cell page.

ground.why: A terminal is a phosphor screen: scan lines, a green glow and a dark bezel.
